objective: Test whether Luna high reasoning rescues end-to-end hard repository tasks that Luna medium cannot solve when Sol naturally routes through RepoTracer Scout.

scope.selection: Chosen before any model run from public task contracts for long-horizon cross-component behavior, with one Rust runtime task and one TypeScript multi-agent task.
not_claimed: A validated Sol classifier for choosing reasoning effort
Cross-repository generality beyond these two tasks

tasks.reason: Crosses Context, Script, Module, nested evaluations, cancellation lineage, and queued jobs with 17 held-out feature checks.
Crosses streamed tool calls, agent registry lookup, recursive execution, feedback, error handling, and cycle detection with 7 held-out feature checks.

execution.routing: Sol receives the retained production routing policy and the original DeepSWE prompt. Scout is neither forced nor named by the benchmark harness.
execution.prompt_policy: Byte-identical official DeepSWE instruction in every arm and repeat.
execution.parent_sandbox: Codex workspace-write with the isolated trial repository .git directory explicitly writable so the official task's branch and commit requirement can run.

controls: Same task base commit and official verifier
Same Sol model, parent reasoning, routing policy, authentication, and Codex configuration
Same RepoTracer binary, Scout prompt, native tools, budgets, and inactivity timeout
Only Scout reasoning_effort differs between medium and high
No task solution or held-out test content is exposed to Sol or Scout
No early stopping after favorable or unfavorable trials

quality: Blind patch and trajectory review after verifier results
routing: Whether Sol used Scout evidence in the implementation
economics: Complete parent plus Scout subscription requests
Input, cached input, output, and reasoning tokens

adaptive_high_requires: High converts a medium verifier failure into a pass in at least two of three repeats for at least one task
High introduces no new required-behavior or preserved-test failure on the other task
The informative task actually invokes Scout
Blind review attributes the rescue to better repository evidence rather than unrelated parent variance
decision_rule.tie: Keep medium; latency or usage cannot justify high without a repeated quality rescue.
decision_rule.insufficient: If Sol does not call Scout or both arms fail for reasons unrelated to repository evidence, retain medium and report that these tasks do not answer the question.

failure_policy.infrastructure: Resample the complete medium/high pair for provider, harness, checkout, or verifier infrastructure failure.
failure_policy.model: Timeout, context exhaustion, bad patch, missed requirement, verifier failure, and unnecessary or missed Scout routing count as observed model behavior.
